Rich hand-painted anime-realistic high fantasy craftsmanship; believable material wear, warm directional highlights and crisp purposeful outer contours. A single equipment design, no extra variants. CITADEL HANDWRAPS. A neatly arranged pair of empty wearable hand coverings, one slightly overlapping the other, with all fingers coherent. Cloth wraps, reinforced leather gloves, chain-backed gloves or articulated plate gauntlets as appropriate. No hands or skin. Articulated brushed silver plate with ivory enamel panels, restrained antique brass trim and dark leather joints; clear forged planes and practical overlapping plates. Compact balanced square silhouette, slight three-quarter view. Compose specifically for 2 columns by 2 rows of square inventory cells, width by height; the object should use about 85 percent of the canvas in its long axis. Isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Entire object visible, centered with generous padding. No floor or scene, no cast shadow, no background card or rectangle, no UI, no border, no labels or text, no watermark, no human or mannequin. Preserve instantly readable silhouette at small inventory size; avoid excessive micro-filigree and avoid turning every object blue and gold.
